top_choice_rationale: P001 rests on a specific, mature discovery chain: Holst's human incretin physiology, Mojsov's identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, and Drucker's proglucagon-derived peptide biology. It is confirmed in independent randomized trials with glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The three-person allocation and the narrowed physiology-and-active-peptide citation fit the named laureates. A no-award outcome would withhold a well-supported achievement, so P000 ranks second.
